title: Bhaiya Mere Bhaiya
body:
bhaiya mere bhaiya, bhaiya mere bhaiya
mai doongi kafan aap ko dafna'ungi laasha
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
aazad hui qaid se lo mil gayi chadar
ay bhai utho qaid se mai aagayi lutkar
mai ashkon se baandh'ungi tere laal ka sehra
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek roz mai is tarha teri laash se guzri
jis tarha ke tujhse mera rishta nahi koi
par ab to zara uthke kaleje se lipatja
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay bhai bahot royi hoo furqat mein tumhari
rone ke siwa karti bhi kya dard ki maari
hotay thay sitam leti thi jab naam tumhara
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas utho dekho behan milne ko aayi
kya baat hai uth'te nahi deti hoo duhaai
hamsheer se moo aapne kis baat pe phera
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaaro se darbaro se zindano se aayi
be-parda phirayi gayi aur maut na aayi
balon se chipati rahi baazaro mein chehra
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan mein sakina ko ajal aagayi bhai
us ghor andhere mein lehad uski banayi
bachi ka kafan bangaya us bachi ka kurta
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ko jakda gaya zanjeere sitam mein
ek ek qadam marti rahi hoo tere gham mein
pardes mein kismat ne nabi zadi ko loota
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha watan ja'un tumhe chor ke ban mein
tanha to nahi ja'ungi ay bhai watan mein
batla'ungi kya jab poochegi jab fatema sughra
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis kis ko nishan rassi ke dikhla'ungi mai jaa kar
na qasim o akbar hai na abbas e dilawar
bin aap ke ghar qabr se to kam nahi hoga
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehan fughan zainab e dilgeer ki sun kar
goya hua hamsheer se yun laasha e sarwar
milta hai sukoon mujhko behan yuhin kahe ja
bhaiya mere bhaiya...
author: Rehaan Azmi
